name: dotnet-standards
description: Two layers. Knowledge: .NET architecture, the in-process messaging pipeline (MediatR + FluentValidation + AutoMapper), EF Core, Redis caching, Elasticsearch, controller-based Web API conventions, testing, and four review rubrics. Process integration: the dotnet-feature and dotnet-review closed-loop flows, which sit on top of the Superpowers plugin and require it.

interface.shortDescription: Personal .NET conventions, review rubrics, and end-to-end feature flows
interface.longDescription: A .NET knowledge layer — facade/module architecture, MediatR messaging, EF Core, API surface, caching, search, file storage, testing — plus four review rubrics and two closed-loop workflows for taking a feature or a review end to end. Project-specific context stays in the repository's own CLAUDE.md, generated by the claude-md-builder skill; AGENTS.md is only a pointer to it.
defaultPrompt: Review the changed .NET code on this branch.
Add a new module feature to this API.
